Proof in the paper: For PdZn_Ordered, the lattice fringes with interplanar distances of 0.121 nm, 0.205 nm, 0.219 nm, and 0.290 nm are in good agreement with PdZn(3 1 1), PdZn(2 0 0), PdZn(1 1 1), and PdZn(1 1 0) crystal planes. For Pd@Zn_Core-shell, the interplanar distances of 0.138 nm, 0.195 nm, and 0.225 nm correspond well with Pd(2 2 0), Pd(2 0 0), and Pd(1 1 1) crystal planes, respectively.
